discovery_candidates.name: Rocket.Chat
discovery_candidates.description: Communications platform that puts data protection first (alternative to Gitter.im and Slack).

discovery_candidates.name: Mattermost
discovery_candidates.description: Platform for secure collaboration across the entire software development lifecycle, can be integrated with Gitlab (alternative to Slack).

discovery_candidates.name: Huly
discovery_candidates.description: All-in-one project management platform (alternative to Linear, Jira, Slack, Notion, Motion).

discovery_candidates.name: Activepieces
discovery_candidates.description: No-code business automation tool like Zapier or Tray. For example, you can send a Slack notification for each new Trello card.

discovery_candidates.name: Apprise
discovery_candidates.description: Apprise allows you to send a notification to almost all of the most popular notification services available to us today such as: Telegram, Discord, Slack, Amazon SNS, Gotify, etc.

discovery_candidates.name: Automatisch
discovery_candidates.description: Business automation tool that lets you connect different services like Twitter, Slack, and more to automate your business processes (alternative to Zapier).

discovery_candidates.name: Colanode
discovery_candidates.description: Collaboration suite with real-time messaging, rich text pages, file management, and dynamic databases - built for offline work (alternative to Slack, Notion).

discovery_candidates.name: tubesync
discovery_candidates.description: Syncs YouTube channels and playlists to a locally hosted media server.

discovery_candidates.name: Talkyard
discovery_candidates.description: Create a community, where your users can suggest ideas and get questions answered. And have friendly open-ended discussions and chat (Slack/StackOverflow/Discourse/Reddit/Disqus hybrid).

discovery_candidates.name: CyTube
discovery_candidates.description: Synchronize media, chat, and more for an arbitrary number of channels.

discovery_candidates.name: Youtarr
discovery_candidates.description: Download videos from YouTube channels on a schedule via yt-dlp, with a web UI to browse and selectively download videos. Integrates with Plex Media Server and generates NFO metadata for Jellyfin, Kodi, and Emby.

discovery_candidates.name: Fredy
discovery_candidates.description: Searches for new apartments, houses, and flats in Germany on platforms like ImmoScout24, Immowelt, and others, and instantly delivers the results to you via Slack, Telegram, and more.

discovery_candidates.name: ChiefOnboarding
discovery_candidates.description: Employee onboarding platform that allows you to provision user accounts and create sequences with todo items, resources, text/email/Slack messages, and more! Available as a web portal and Slack bot.

discovery_candidates.name: vod2pod-rss
discovery_candidates.description: Convert YouTube and Twitch channels to podcasts, no storage required. Transcodes VoDs to MP3 192k on the fly, generates an RSS feed to use in podcast clients.

discovery_candidates.name: ChannelTube
discovery_candidates.description: Download video or audio from YouTube channels on a schedule via yt-dlp.
